dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: No, no, no, this isn't right... The word about the rift between the Qixing and the Fatui should be out by now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have you ever stopped to consider that maybe this "secret intel" of yours is being "leaked" to you on purpose?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: You mean, this is a ploy by the Qixing to control small and medium business owners?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Based on our interactions with others, it seems like you're the only one getting duped.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I... I've been scammed... by Ningguang...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not going to ask me to return my stuff now, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Integrity is the cornerstone of being a merchant, so I won't go back on my word but... But... this is terrible...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, don't give up! You've still got a long life to lead!

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: You're right. My heart wasn't in the right place. How could the Qixing ever turn their backs on the people of Liyue in order to make a profit? Those everyday items are a necessity for the people to just get by. No one should attempt to corner the market like that, and I shouldn't have allowed myself to go along with it.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Friend, you have seen with your own eyes my very rise and fall. Let my mistakes be a lesson for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That lesson being... to not become a merchant?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm going to need some time to myself to think about what's happened. Business will at least continue to go on, but in the immediate sense that doesn't help me a whole lot...
